staticConsumerFinding.finding: McpTab does not require or await openExternal. Missing platform support or a rejected platform Promise bypasses the component catch and leaves polling until its five-minute budget. Moreover existing Electron handler neither returns/awaits shell.openExternal nor exposes failures through its best-effort wrapper; component-only await cannot establish native OS failure feedback.
staticConsumerFinding.minimumCheck: At the actual McpTab control, reject platform.openExternal and assert visible failure without continuing OAuth polling; this is consumer mechanism proof. To claim real native failure feedback, bind the real shell Promise to an observable IPC result and verify that path separately.
staticConsumerFinding.limit: No OS/browser error was executed here. Do not label this a reproduced product failure or claim model-provider coverage proves it.
